physical_model.basis_encoding: Computational index = n + N; qubit 0 is least significant.

exact_reference.usage: Validation only; never used to choose angles or optimizer candidates.

scope.local_mode: Exact statevector energies and finite-shot ideal overlap samples; not a device-noise simulation.
scope.hardware_mode: Runtime energy measurements and raw Sampler compute-uncompute probabilities.
scope.uncertainty: Statistical/repeat estimates assuming independent energy sampling; gate/readout bias and device drift are not fully accounted for. Overlap uncertainty is Wilson half-width/1.96.
scope.shot_budget: Energy shots are per measurement configuration, not total shots over all Pauli terms or mitigations.
scope.timings: Wall time includes submission, queue, execution and local processing; not pure QPU time.

ground_selection.criterion: Lowest independently remeasured mean cost with a statistical improvement guard relative to the warm start. This heuristic is not a global optimum or confidence guarantee.
